pages.title: Diamond Singularity
pages.text: A hoard of diamonds crushed into a single brilliant point. Diamond is already carbon at its hardest; compressed further, it becomes something harder still. It scatters light into every colour and is cold to the touch.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Diamonds are carbon under pressure, so I applied more pressure. The Singularity Compactor crushed the gems into a single blazing point that scratches anything.
